description: This file is a client-side API module for interacting with a backend service that performs resume and job description matching. It defines functions to detect the backend URL and to send resume files and job descriptions via a POST request to retrieve match scores and feedback.
external_methods: process.env (Node.js environment variable access, usage in bundling)

methods.name: detectBaseUrl()
methods.description: Determines the backend URL based on environment variables, auto-detection of current window location, or defaults to localhost.

methods.name: postMatch({ file, jobDescription, signal, timeoutMs = 60000 })
methods.description: Sends a resume file and job description to the backend /match endpoint and returns the parsing JSON with match scoring and feedback.

ctags.name: postMatch
ctags.pattern: /^export async function postMatch({ file, jobDescription, signal, timeoutMs = 60000 }) {$/
